purpose: Conservative fail-closed availability rule for CFTC COT observations before any B3 economics.

normal_rule.rationale: CFTC states normal Friday 15:30 ET release and holiday delays of one or two days. Plus nine calendar days moves use to Thursday after the report-as-of Tuesday, strictly later than normal Friday and ordinary holiday-delayed Monday/Tuesday releases.

exception_policy.rule: If an official special announcement gives an actual/new publication date later than the conservative normal-rule timestamp, the later official publication date governs. If a special announcement indicates interruption but exact publication is unresolved, affected observations are unavailable until resolved.

known_2025_shutdown.policy: Use only the official CFTC catch-up publication schedule for affected report dates; never apply the normal +9-day rule inside the interrupted backlog window.

b3_join_rule.selection: For each B3 session use the most recent CFTC report whose effective_available_at is strictly earlier than the B3 session signal time.
